📖 How to Submit B.Ed Assignments (Step by Step)

  • Online Submission: Login to Aaghi LMS Portal (aaghi.aiou.edu.pk) → Go to your course → Click "Add Submission" → Upload PDF → Save.
  • Offline Submission: Write neatly on assignment sheets → Attach assignment form → Submit at regional office or tutor's address.
  • Always keep a copy and take a screenshot as proof of submission.
  • Deadline tip: Submit at least 3 days before the due date to avoid last‑minute server or courier issues.

🎯 Exam Strategy for B.Ed Students (From a Tutor)

  • ✅ Start preparing at least 2 months before exams – revise one course per week.
  • ✅ Focus on past papers – AIOU repeats 50‑60% of questions.
  • ✅ For theory subjects (8601, 8602, 8605), write answers with headings, bullet points, and real classroom examples.
  • ✅ For teaching methods courses (6400, 6403, 6406), include lesson planning, learning objectives, and assessment techniques.
  • ✅ Never submit copied assignments – write in your own words to avoid plagiarism and secure higher marks.
  • ✅ Practice time management – allocate 10 minutes for MCQs, 30 minutes for short questions, and 80 minutes for long questions.

📖 How to Download and Use These AIOU Original Books

📚 Key Books (Helping Books) – What You Need to Know

Key books (guides) provide solved assignments, chapter summaries, and additional practice questions. In the table, most codes have Available – these are published by Caravan, Dogar, Ilmi, etc. For some advanced courses, key books may be limited – you must rely on the original textbook and your tutor’s guidance.

Where to buy key books? Urdu Bazaar (Lahore), Saddar (Karachi), or online at Daraz.pk. We also provide free solved assignments for many courses on our solved assignments page.

⚠️ Important: Key books are for reference only. Never copy answers directly – AIOU uses plagiarism detection. Always read the original book first, then use the key book to check your understanding.

🎯 Tips to Score High Marks in MLIS Using Original Books

  • ✅ Read the original textbook chapter thoroughly before looking at any key book.
  • ✅ For practical papers (classification, cataloguing): Practice DDC and AACR2 rules.
  • ✅ For theory papers: Focus on key definitions, historical developments, and modern trends.
  • ✅ Make your own notes – writing helps memory.
  • ✅ Practice past papers available in key books – at least 5 years of past papers.
  • ✅ Use our solved assignments to verify your answers before final submission.

📌 Information We Collect

We collect several types of information from and about users of our website, including:

  • Personal Information: When you voluntarily contact us via our contact form, email, or WhatsApp, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, and any message details you provide.
  • Non-Personal Information: We automatically collect certain usage data when you visit our site, such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, pages viewed, and the dates/times of visits. This helps us analyze trends and improve user experience.
  • Cookies & Tracking Technologies: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance functionality, personalize content, and display relevant advertisements (via Google AdSense). You can control cookies through your browser settings.

🍪 Cookies & Google AdSense

Assignmentwaly uses Google AdSense to serve ads. Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to our website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to our site and/or other sites on the Internet.

✅ Google AdSense & Personalized Ads: You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. Alternatively, you can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info.

We also use cookies to remember user preferences, track engagement, and improve site performance. Third-party services (such as analytics providers or ad networks) may place cookies as well. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings; however, some features of our site may not function properly.

📧 How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect from you for the following purposes:

  • To respond to your inquiries, support requests, or assignment-related questions.
  • To improve our website content, user interface, and overall experience.
  • To display personalized or contextual advertisements through Google AdSense.
  • To analyze site traffic and usage patterns via analytics tools.
  • To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraudulent activity.

🔐 Data Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share non-personal, aggregated information (such as demographic data) with partners or advertisers. We may disclose personal information if required by law, to protect our rights, or to investigate potential violations. Third-party service providers (such as email hosting or analytics) may have access to your data solely to perform tasks on our behalf.

📢 Third-Party Links & Services

Our website may contain links to external sites (e.g., reference materials, educational resources). We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those third-party websites. We encourage you to read their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

🛡️ Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

🌍 Your Privacy Rights (GDPR & CCPA)

For European Economic Area (EEA) residents under GDPR: You have the right to access, correct, update, or request deletion of your personal data. You may also restrict or object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

For California residents under CCPA: You have the right to request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information we collect, request deletion of your personal data, and opt-out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell your data). We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights.

📩 To make a request regarding your data: Email us at faiezhafeez@gmail.com with the subject "Privacy Request". We will respond within 30 days.

👶 Children's Privacy

Assignmentwaly does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately. If we discover that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we will delete such data promptly.

📝 Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or operational needs. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective date". We encourage you to review this page periodically. Your continued use of the website after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

✍️ How to Use AIOU Guess Papers to Score 85+ Marks

Guess papers are powerful only when used correctly. Follow this proven strategy to maximize your exam performance:

⚠️ Critical AIOU Submission Rules: Know Your Category

AIOU assignments are graded under two distinct methodologies. Failure to follow your program's specific protocol will lead to instant disqualification.

📝 Category A: Physical Submission (Handwritten Only)

Applicable Programs: Matric, Intermediate (FA, F.Sc, I.Com), and Bachelor (BA, B.Com / Associate Degree Programs).

  • Must be fully handwritten on clean, single-sided sheets.
  • You must attach three copies of the official "Assignment Form" (Pertal / پرتال) with each solved assignment.
  • These papers must be physically packed and sent via Pakistan Post (Registry) or TCS to your assigned tutor's mailing address.

💻 Category B: Online Upload (Digital Typing Only)

Applicable Programs: BS, B.Ed (1.5, 2.5, 4 Years), Associate Degree in Education (ADE), MA, MSc, M.Com, and MLIS.

  • Assignments must be digitally typed in MS Word and converted to PDF format before uploading.
  • Urdu assignments can be typed in InPage or MS Word (using Urdu keyboard layouts) and converted to PDF.
  • Files must be uploaded directly to the Aaghi LMS Portal (aaghi.aiou.edu.pk) under your login credentials.
  • Strict Warning: Never scan handwritten pages and upload them as PDFs on LMS. AIOU filters will flag this, and tutors will assign zero marks.

✍️ How to Write AIOU Assignments to Secure 90+ Marks

Tutors scan hundreds of assignments in a limited time. To grab their attention and secure top grades, follow these practical, human-tested strategies:

  • Do Not Mindlessly Copy-Paste: Tutors easily recognize identical wording from standard keys. Read our solved assignment PDF, understand the core concept, and rewrite the answer in your own natural words.
  • Use Clear Structural Formatting: Break long answers into readable chunks. Use black markers for headings, sub-headings, and blue ink for writing details (for handwritten papers). Use bold headers for LMS typed files.
  • Incorporate Real-Life Examples: Adding a localized Pakistani case study, recent statistics, or a brief flowchart elevates the quality of your assignment instantly.
  • Strictly Follow the Word Limit: If the question asks for 500 words, keep your answers concise. Stretching the content unnecessarily leads to low grades.
⚠️ Pro Tip for Physical Mailing: Always send assignments using "Registered Post" via Pakistan Post or reputable courier services. Keep the physical booking receipt safe until your final semester results are announced on the CMS portal. This receipt is your official legal proof if your tutor misplaces your marks sheet.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (AIOU Student Guide)

📌 Are these solved AIOU assignments completely free?
Yes. All assignment drafts and PDFs on Assignmentwaly are 100% free. They are structured by subject teachers to act as ideal research guidelines and notes for students.
📌 Can I scan handwritten papers and upload them to the LMS portal?
Absolutely not. This is a very common mistake that BS and B.Ed students make. If you upload scanned images of handwritten sheets on Aaghi LMS, the system will flag the format, and your tutor has the authority to award you zero marks. You must type your answers digitally in MS Word or PDF.
📌 What should I do if my tutor list is not allotted yet?
If your semester tutor names or addresses are not displaying on the CMS portal, do not stop working! Write and complete your assignments beforehand. Keep checking your CMS account daily, or contact your local AIOU regional office if the deadline is approaching.
📌 How do I check if my LMS uploaded assignment is submitted?
When you upload your PDF on the Aaghi LMS, make sure to click "Submit Assignment" and ensure the status changes from "Draft (Not Submitted)" to "Submitted for Grading" in green color. If it remains a draft, the tutor won't be able to grade it.
📌 Can I use InPage Urdu for typing solved assignments?
Yes, you can type in InPage, export the files as PDF, and upload them to the LMS. Alternatively, you can use MS Word with a phonetics Urdu keyboard layout, which is much easier to export as a clean PDF document.

📝 How to Apply Online – Step by Step

  1. Visit the official AIOU admission portal: admissions.aiou.edu.pk
  2. Create an account using your CNIC/B-Form number and email.
  3. Select your program (FA, I.Com, BA, BS, etc.) and fill the online form.
  4. Upload scanned documents (photograph, CNIC, previous degrees).
  5. Pay admission fee via 1Bill, EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or bank challan.
  6. Submit the form and print the admission slip for future reference.

💰 Fee Structure & Payment Methods

AIOU fees vary by program. For Intermediate (FA/I.Com) the approximate fee per semester is PKR 4,500–6,000. You can pay via ATM, mobile banking, EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or any HBL/UBL branch. After payment, upload the proof on the admission portal.

⚠️ Note: Late fee submission results in a fine of PKR 500–1000. Always keep the payment receipt safe.

🎓 Required Documents for Admission

  • CNIC / B-Form (for minors) – copy
  • Recent passport-size photograph (with blue background)
  • Previous educational certificates (Matric for intermediate, Intermediate for bachelor)
  • Domicile certificate (optional but recommended)
  • Admission processing fee challan receipt
